description: A filter has an indexed base s_i selected by a predicate p when a set belongs to the filter exactly when it contains some s_i with p(i). A family B is represented by indexing over all subsets with selection predicate membership in B.
signature: Filter.HasBasis.{u_1, u_3} {α : Type u_1} {ι : Sort u_3} (l : Filter α) (p : ι → Prop) (s : ι → Set α) : Prop
